expected_sharpe: 1.3-1.6 standalone (miss market anchoring on SRW); INTERPOLATION-CORE target Sharpe >=1.3

Trade credit ratio = AP/(AP+financial debt). 4-factor alpha 2.7% pa (4.9% for constrained firms). Mechanism: suppliers extend credit to buyers with high sales potential = favorable private info.

paper: Peters & Taylor (2017) JFE — 'Intangible Capital and the Investment-q Relation'. Eisfeldt & Kim (2021) NBER — 'Intangible Value'. Bongaerts et al. (2021) SSRN — 'Intangibles Premium'. Intangible intensity = (capitalized R&D + partial SGA) / total assets. Annual return 4.6%, Sharpe 0.51 for INT factor. Mechanism: market undervalues off-balance-sheet intangibles.
